text:
harper: Quick follow-up from the March 17 incident - throughput dips + intermittent p95 spikes. Want to lock owners for remediation, add a recurrence metric we can action on, and decide if we need a temporary SLO guardrail. Keeping this tight.

lee: TL;DR: brief autoscaler rollback during a small traffic surge caused imbalance; slow-path CPU fallback in one AZ amplified tail latency. We saw the same fingerprint twice in the last 21 days. Burned ~1.9% of error budget this cycle.

sre-bot: Runbook engine: recommend adding a computed "recurrence_index" (count of similar fingerprints / 30d) and surface it on the SLO dashboard.

harper: I like a recurrence_index. Proposal: ops adds tile + an alert that pages when recurrence_index > 2 and p95 breach rate > 10% over 24h. Product: we'll avoid changing public SLOs unless burn >2.5% after fixes.

infra: I'll build a small dashboard card: recurrence_index, 24h p95 breach rate, and zone heatmap. ETA 2026-03-29. Draft alert below:
```
alert: ServiceRecurrenceIndex
expr: (recurrence_index > 2) and (increase(service_latency_p95[24h]) / max(1, increase(service_request_count[24h])) > 0.10)
for: 1h
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "Recurring tail latency pattern detected (recurrence_index > 2)"
```
Pages only on sustained recurrence.

lee: For immediate mitigations: small autoscaler dampening, cap max batch size for background jobs, and a fast fallback throttle. I can own the batch cap + small PR. ETA 2026-03-20.

harper: I'll own the autoscaler dampening plan and bench scripts. Proposed timeline: 1 week bench, 3 days staging canary, 1 week gradual prod roll. ETA full rollout 2026-04-10.

product: We'll hold on permanent SLO changes. If after the planned rollouts monthly burn exceeds 2.5% we will prepare customer comms and consider SLA adjustments. For now product approves the operational guardrail approach.

sre-bot: Suggested runbook update: when recurrence_index > 2, automatically create a tickler and tag incident as recurrence-prone.

infra: Actions & owners (pls ack): - recurrence_index dashboard + alert: infra, ETA 2026-03-29 - batch cap PR: lee, ETA 2026-03-20 - autoscaler dampening + bench: harper, ETA 2026-04-10 - runbook automation for recurrence: infra, ETA 2026-03-25

lee: ack 1:03. PR link soon.

harper: ack 1:04. Starting bench run tomorrow.

infra: ack 1:06. Dashboard PR: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/dashboards/pulls/177

sre-bot: Canary scheduled by harper at 3991240000. Notifying oncall.

harper: I'll post a 1-line status every Friday here. If anyone misses ETA ping me and we'll escalate.

product: Thanks all. Goal: stop error-budget drift and avoid changing public SLOs unless absolutely necessary. Keep cadence weekly in this thread.
